key_insight: A no-code, in-house LLM workflow can automate row-by-row analysis of tabular clinical data while keeping PHI inside a secure environment.
clinical_relevance: This could speed up chart review and data extraction for research teams working with EMR, pathology, imaging, or registry data.
method: Imports Excel or text tabular data into a user-friendly interface
Guides users through prompt setup for extraction or summarization tasks
Automatically sends each row to an internal ChatGPT 4o-mini and tabulates the outputs
evidence_signal: The abstract reports successful deployment across multiple data sources, but it does not provide quantitative performance metrics or formal validation results.
watch_item: Real-world use still depends on careful prompt design, secure deployment, and checking outputs for accuracy and consistency.
paper_title: A user-friendly, no-code, application for HIPAA-compliant automated analysis of tabular data at scale
